cohort: 300 primigravid women with live singleton pregnancies, 150 adolescents (≤19 years) and 150 adults (≥20 years)
finding: Primiparous adolescents had a significantly higher risk of preterm delivery, low birth weight infants, and anemia compared to adult primiparas.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery was similar between groups (39.2 weeks in adolescents vs. 39.4 weeks in adults)
